aToB.memory: Sharing Mooncrest Hall, Herbology Class, and Dueling Class with Soren has taught Kaede to trust quiet reliability over loud boasts. Whenever she runs full-speed wind slashes in the Dueling Courtyard, Soren reinforces the perimeter barrier stones without complaint—and once balanced a scarred scabbard clasp for her in three quiet minutes when she thought it was ruined.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Kaede wants to thank Soren squarely for strengthening the Dueling Courtyard's north containment plates and ask briefly whether her wind-bursts have been stressing the southern wards.

bToA.memory: Soren respects Kaede across Mooncrest Hall, Herbology Class, and the Dueling Courtyard because she works hard without pretension, respects sparring limits, and treats steel with real care. They can check a chipped granite ward ring together in three straightforward sentences, and he occasionally leaves an anonymous honey-almond tart near her door after brutal practice days.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Soren wants to let Kaede know the Dueling Courtyard's boundary anchors are freshly seated for full-force sparring and check concisely if she noticed any vibration along the east edge.
